OnlineUsers.description: Settings related to the online users feature.

Enable.description: Enable or disable the online users feature. This is used to indicate the number of online users in the backoffice and display their names.

Sounds.description: Settings related to the sounds played for user login and logout events.

Enable.description: Enable or disable the audio notifications for user login and logout events.

LoginSound.description: Path to the login sound file. This can be a relative path or an absolute URL.

LogoutSound.description: Path to the logout sound file. This can be a relative path or an absolute URL.

SignalRClientLogLevel.description: Used to set the log level of the SignalR Javascript client.

WebRTC.description: Settings for the WebRTC audio calling feature between backoffice users.

Enable.description: Enable or disable the WebRTC audio calling feature. When disabled, call buttons are hidden from the online users modal. This setting is reactively applied without restart.

StunServers.description: STUN server URLs used for ICE candidate gathering. Defaults to Google's free public STUN servers.

TurnServers.description: Optional TURN relay servers for environments where peer-to-peer connections cannot be established directly (e.g. symmetric NAT, strict firewalls). Leave empty to rely on STUN only. Used when TurnServer.Provider is 'Static'.

TurnServer.description: Dynamic TURN credential provider. Changing 'Provider' requires an application restart. Credential values (API keys) are reactive without restart.

Provider.description: 'None' = STUN only (default). 'Static' = use TurnServers array. 'Cloudflare'/'Twilio'/'Metered' = dynamic credentials via provider REST API. Changing this requires an application restart.

KeyId.description: TURN Key ID from Cloudflare Realtime dashboard.

ApiToken.description: API Token with TURN key permissions.

Ttl.description: Token lifetime in seconds. Maximum 86400 (24 hours).

Twilio.description: Twilio Network Traversal Service credential settings.

Metered.description: Metered.ca TURN server credential settings. Also supports the free Open Relay service (AppName: 'openrelay', ApiKey: 'openrelayproject').

AppName.description: Your Metered app subdomain (e.g. 'myapp' for myapp.metered.live). Use 'openrelay' for the free Open Relay service.

ApiKey.description: API key from the Metered dashboard. Use 'openrelayproject' for the free Open Relay service.

CacheTtlSeconds.description: How long to cache the returned credentials in seconds. Metered credentials are valid for 24 hours; default is 23 hours (82800s).

RingTimeoutSeconds.description: Number of seconds to ring before automatically timing out if the callee doesn't answer. Default is 20.

Sounds.description: Sound files played during WebRTC call events.

RingSound.description: Path to the sound played on the callee's side when an incoming call arrives.

RingbackSound.description: Path to the sound played on the caller's side while waiting for the callee to answer.
